mapper.sql: FROM catalog.dataset d JOIN catalog.publication p ON p.id = d.now_pstg_id AND p.dtset_id = d.id JOIN catalog.dataset_revision r ON r.id = p.rvsn_id AND r.dtset_id = d.id JOIN identity.organization o ON o.id = r.pvsn_inst_id JOIN identity.organization owner_org ON owner_org.id = d.psn_inst_id LEFT JOIN classification.category c ON c.id = r.main_clsf_id WHERE d.mng_stts_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND p.stts_cd = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.stts_cd = 'APPROVED' AND r.rls_rng_cd = 'PUBLIC' AND o.stts_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND owner_org.stts_cd = 'ACTIVE'

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog.revision_discovery rd WHERE rd.rvsn_id=r.id AND rd.type_cd='REGION' AND rd.clsf_id IN #{id})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog.revision_discovery rd WHERE rd.rvsn_id=r.id AND rd.type_cd='HUB' AND rd.clsf_id IN #{id})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog.revision_topic rt WHERE rt.rvsn_id=r.id AND rt.tpc_id IN #{id})

otherwise.if: AND (r.ttl ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR r.expln ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.sql: concat_ws(' ',r.ttl,r.expln, , COALESCE(r.mtdt_cn #>> '{publicationLabels,providerOrganizationName}',o.inst_nm), COALESCE(r.mtdt_cn #>> '{publicationLabels,primaryCategoryName}',c.nm), (SELECT string_agg(label.value #>> '{}',' ') FROM jsonb_path_query(r.mtdt_cn,'$.discovery.regions[*].name') label(value)), (SELECT string_agg(label.value #>> '{}',' ') FROM jsonb_path_query(r.mtdt_cn,'$.discovery.hubs[*].name') label(value)), (SELECT string_agg(label.value #>> '{}',' ') FROM jsonb_path_query(r.mtdt_cn,'$.discovery.topics[*].name') label(value)))

(SELECT string_agg(keyword.value,' ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.mtdt_cn #> '{details,keywords}')='array' THEN r.mtdt_cn #> '{details,keywords}' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) keyword(value))

(SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'firstPublishedAt', COALESCE((SELECT min(first_p.pstg_dt) FROM catalog.publication first_p JOIN catalog.dataset_revision first_r ON first_r.id=first_p.rvsn_id WHERE first_p.dtset_id=d.id AND first_r.dtset_id=d.id AND first_r.rls_rng_cd='PUBLIC'),p.pstg_dt), 'metadataCollectedAt', linked.collected_at, 'collectionStatus', COALESCE(linked.collection_status,'NOT_LINKED'))::text FROM (VALUES (1)) AS singleton(n) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(item.mdfcn_dt, collected.end_dt, s.mdfcn_dt) AS collected_at, CASE WHEN NOT conn.use_yn THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE COALESCE(latest.stts_cd,'NOT_COLLECTED') END AS collection_status FROM integration.source_metadata s JOIN integration.source_connection conn ON conn.id=s.sou_lnkg_id AND conn.inst_id=d.psn_inst_id JOIN integration.sync_run collected ON collected.id=s.last_excn_id AND collected.sou_lnkg_id=conn.id LEFT JOIN integration.sync_item item ON item.sync_excn_id=collected.id AND item.otsd_id=s.otsd_id AND item.stts_cd IN ('CANDIDATE','UNCHANGED') LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT run.stts_cd FROM integration.sync_run run WHERE run.sou_lnkg_id=conn.id AND run.type_cd='SYNC' ORDER BY run.crt_dt DESC,run.id DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true WHERE s.dtset_id=d.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM integration.candidate_application applied WHERE applied.sou_mtdt_id=s.id AND applied.dtset_id=d.id AND applied.dtset_rvsn_id=p.rvsn_id) ORDER BY COALESCE(item.mdfcn_dt,collected.end_dt,s.mdfcn_dt) DESC,s.id LIMIT 1 ) linked ON true) AS freshness
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id::text AS id, r.ttl AS title, r.expln AS description, o.id::text AS organization_id, COALESCE(r.mtdt_cn #>> '{publicationLabels,providerOrganizationName}', o.inst_nm) AS organization_name, c.id::text AS category_id, COALESCE(r.mtdt_cn #>> '{publicationLabels,primaryCategoryName}', c.nm) AS category_name, p.pstg_dt AS published_at, p.acs_stts_cd AS access_state,r.mtdt_cn::text AS metadata,p.pstg_no AS publication_no,
ORDER BY
r.ttl ASC, r.ttl DESC, p.pstg_dt ASC,
( CASE WHEN r.ttl ILIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!' THEN 4 WHEN ILIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!' THEN 3 WHEN r.expln ILIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ) DESC,p.pstg_dt DESC,
CASE WHEN lower(r.ttl)=lower(#{q}) THEN 0 WHEN r.ttl ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.pstg_dt DESC, p.pstg_dt DESC,
d.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.id::text AS id, o.inst_nm AS name, count(DISTINCT d.id) AS count
GROUP BY o.id,o.inst_nm ORDER BY o.inst_nm,o.id

SELECT c.id::text AS id, c.nm AS name, count(DISTINCT d.id) AS count
AND c.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id,c.nm ORDER BY c.nm,c.id

SELECT rd.clsf_id::text AS id,min(rd.nm_snpst) AS name,count(DISTINCT s.id) AS count FROM catalog.revision_discovery rd JOIN ( SELECT d.id,r.id AS revision_id
) s ON s.revision_id=rd.rvsn_id WHERE rd.type_cd='REGION' GROUP BY rd.clsf_id ORDER BY name,rd.clsf_id

SELECT rd.clsf_id::text AS id,min(rd.nm_snpst) AS name,count(DISTINCT s.id) AS count FROM catalog.revision_discovery rd JOIN ( SELECT d.id,r.id AS revision_id
) s ON s.revision_id=rd.rvsn_id WHERE rd.type_cd='HUB' GROUP BY rd.clsf_id ORDER BY name,rd.clsf_id

SELECT rt.tpc_id::text AS id,min(rt.nm_snpst) AS name,count(DISTINCT s.id) AS count FROM catalog.revision_topic rt JOIN ( SELECT d.id,r.id AS revision_id
) s ON s.revision_id=rt.rvsn_id GROUP BY rt.tpc_id ORDER BY name,rt.tpc_id
mapper.sql: FROM catalog.dataset d JOIN catalog.publication current_p ON current_p.id=d.now_pstg_id AND current_p.dtset_id=d.id JOIN catalog.dataset_revision current_r ON current_r.id=current_p.rvsn_id AND current_r.dtset_id=d.id JOIN identity.organization current_o ON current_o.id=current_r.pvsn_inst_id JOIN identity.organization owner_org ON owner_org.id=d.psn_inst_id JOIN catalog.publication p ON p.dtset_id=d.id JOIN catalog.dataset_revision r ON r.id=p.rvsn_id AND r.dtset_id=d.id JOIN identity.organization o ON o.id=r.pvsn_inst_id LEFT JOIN classification.category c ON c.id=r.main_clsf_id WHERE d.id=#{id} AND d.mng_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND owner_org.stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND current_p.stts_cd='PUBLISHED' AND current_r.stts_cd='APPROVED' AND current_r.rls_rng_cd='PUBLIC' AND current_o.stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND p.stts_cd='PUBLISHED' AND r.stts_cd='APPROVED' AND r.rls_rng_cd='PUBLIC' AND o.stts_cd='ACTIVE'
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id::text AS id,r.ttl AS title,r.expln AS description,o.id::text AS organization_id,COALESCE(r.mtdt_cn #>> '{publicationLabels,providerOrganizationName}',o.inst_nm) AS organization_name, c.id::text AS category_id,COALESCE(r.mtdt_cn #>> '{publicationLabels,primaryCategoryName}',c.nm) AS category_name,p.pstg_dt AS published_at,p.acs_stts_cd AS access_state,p.pstg_no AS publication_no,r.mtdt_cn::text AS metadata,
AND p.pstg_no=#{publicationNo}AND p.id=d.now_pstg_id

SELECT p.pstg_no AS publication_no,p.pstg_dt AS published_at,(p.id=d.now_pstg_id) AS current
ORDER BY p.pstg_no DESC
